studio.seoTitle: Jana Video Pendek Dalam Talian Secara Percuma dengan AI — FreeShortVideo Studio
studio.seoDescription: FreeShortVideo Studio: jana video pendek dalam talian secara percuma dengan AI. Masukkan idea, AI memecahnya kepada 2-5 adegan, menjana video dan mencantum dalam pelayar. Tanpa pemasangan, tanpa GPU, tanpa kad kredit.
studio.seoH1: Jana Video Pendek Dalam Talian Secara Percuma dengan AI — FreeShortVideo Studio
studio.seoIntro: FreeShortVideo Studio ialah penjana video pendek AI versi web: masukkan idea, AI memecahnya kepada 2-5 adegan, menjana video 5 saat setiap adegan dan mencantumkannya menjadi video pendek lengkap dalam pelayar anda. Percuma sepenuhnya, tanpa pemasangan, tanpa GPU, tanpa kad kredit — cuma tambah kunci Agnes API percuma.
studio.title: Bengkel Video Kreatif
studio.subtitle: AI Penulis Skrip → Teks-ke-Video Berbilang Segmen → Cantuman Pelayar
studio.apiKeyHint: Mulakan dengan API Key Agnes AI percuma. Tanpa kad kredit.

apiKey.title: Tetapan API Key
apiKey.label: Agnes API Key
apiKey.requiredHint: Mulakan dengan API key Agnes AI percuma. Tiada kad kredit.
apiKey.localOnly: Kunci hanya disimpan dalam localStorage pelayar anda dan tidak pernah dimuat naik ke mana-mana pelayan. Anda perlu memasukkannya semula selepas membersihkan data pelayar.

studio.ideaPlaceholder: Huraikan tema video, cth: Kisah penyembuhan anak kucing liar menemui rumah hangat di bandar
studio.ideaHint: Idea yang lebih spesifik menghasilkan adegan lebih koheren. Sertakan tema, mood, plot utama.
studio.durationHint: Semakin lama tempoh, semakin lama penjanaan. Sehingga 12 saat.
studio.timeHint: Pemecahan adegan kira-kira 10-20 saat, penjanaan video kira-kira 3-5 minit setiap segmen.
studio.generatingHint: Menjana video segmen demi segmen, sila tunggu. Setiap segmen 3-5 minit.
studio.ffmpegLoadingHint: Kegunaan pertama memuat turun ffmpeg.wasm (~30MB), cache selepas itu.
studio.concatenatingHint: Menyatukan resolusi dan mencantum semua segmen menjadi video akhir.
studio.completedNote: Video ini dijana dan dicantum sepenuhnya dalam pelayar anda. Versi pertama tanpa narasi AI dan sari kata, akan ditambah secara beransur-ansur.
studio.concatWithFailedHint: Some scenes failed; only completed scenes will be concatenated
studio.errorHint_invalidApiKey: Please check your API Key and re-enter it above.
studio.errorHint_rateLimited: Video submission is limited to 1 per minute. Please wait and retry.
studio.errorHint_network: Check your network connection. If it persists, the API service may be temporarily unavailable.
studio.errorHint_submitFailed: Submission failed due to rate limiting or service fluctuation. Click "Retry Failed Scenes" to auto-retry.
studio.errorHint_pollTimeout: Generation timed out (>30 min). The service may be congested; try again later.
studio.errorHint_maxConsecutiveFailures: 10 consecutive poll failures. Check your connection and retry.
studio.errorHint_videoFailed: Remote video generation failed. Try adjusting the prompt and retry.
studio.errorHint_downloadFailed: Video download failed. The remote video domain does not support CORS; recording mode is used automatically. If it persists, the link may have expired — regenerate.
studio.errorHint_concatFailed: Concatenation failed, likely due to inconsistent video formats. Ensure all scenes completed.
studio.errorHint_aborted: Generation cancelled. Click "Retry Failed Scenes" to continue unfinished parts.
studio.errorHint_scriptFailed: Scene splitting failed. Check your API Key or network.
studio.partialFailedHint: Some scenes failed. Retry failed scenes or concatenate only completed ones.
studio.errorHint_sceneFailed: Some scenes failed. Click "Retry Failed Scenes" to auto-retry (completed scenes will be skipped).
